publisher: United States Bureau of Economic Analysis
ownership: United States federal government public-domain aggregate data
prohibited_use: representing GDP as a business count, named-business directory, or collection-completeness measure
allocating national, regional, state, county, or combined-area GDP to ZIP codes or ZCTAs without a published source relationship
duplicating a BEA combined-area value onto any constituent county or county-equivalent
converting not-available, not-meaningful, or unpublished values to zero
attribution: Source: U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis, CAGDP1 County GDP Summary.
retention: Indefinite for public aggregate source releases and derived artifacts unless an approved retention rule applies.
redistribution: Allowed with publisher, source table, reference year, units, transformation version, flags, geography limitations, and provenance. Citation is appreciated by BEA.
